Start.Name: original_01_85da4234ba0f
Start.Text: 哎呀，祐天寺同学。早上好

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_01_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_16_002
l2d_voice#2.Text: 真稀奇。 我有安排了

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_04_original_03_08cc33278aab
l2d_voice#2.Text: 嗯，你的想法好像有些变化了呢

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_05_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_16_004
l2d_voice#2.Text: 结束之后我就可以过去了。 有什么事？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_06_original_05_04491efef597
l2d_voice#2.Text: 『三角同学更是音讯全无，也不来上学』

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_07_original_08_580ed87592d5
l2d_voice#2.Text: （但也一直没有什么进展，这样真的好吗……）

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_08_original_06_7244b3727d73
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我们也来一曲如何？看在同是节奏组的缘分上

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_09_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_16_017
l2d_voice#2.Text: 让你们久等了。 如果你们在忙的话，需要我待会儿再过来吗？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_10_adv_voice_mujica_002_1_03_051
l2d_voice#2.Text: ……好险。倒是没想到你会把包扔给我呢。 罢了，反正也不是特别重要的东西
